'''Chris Westergard''' (also listed as '''Chris Westergaard''') is a Star Wars CCG tournament player. The 2009 Match Play Championship pre-registration list gave his state as Maryland (MD) and his username as ''yodad''.<ref name="t22347">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=22347 MPC 2009 pre-registration list], Star Wars CCG Players Committee forum (9 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012213614/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22347.html Internet Archive]</ref>
